# Part 2 designs D and B (text benchmark)

**EXPLORATORY, post-hoc: escalation targets chosen after the Part 2 results were seen (not pre-registered)**

From saved replies only (`part2_designs_exploratory.yaml`); choices in WORKLOG 2026-10-13, "Part 2 design analysis". Numbers only.

- Accuracy: the exact answer per question (Q2 and Q4: exact severity level, as in Fig 4). Mean of 4 = each item's share of its 4 questions right, averaged over items. 95% CIs: Wilson for one question, bootstrap over items for the mean of 4. An unanswered question is wrong.
- $: logged tokens x `configs/prices.yaml` (checked 2026-10-12), per 1,000 items. Latency: the median over items of the item's calls added up (a routed item waits for both).
- D: an item's confidence is its lowest top-option probability over the 4 questions. At a fixed share, the lowest-confidence items go to the LLM (ties by item id), which answers all 4 questions for them. The perfect router sends only the items where the LLM gets more right: a bound, not a system.
- B: one LLM call answers all 4 questions, so any split that uses the LLM costs both calls.
